fixed_component: Seed trifluoroethyl carbonyl; exact model requires operational confirmation
target: Preserve carbonyl scaffold; variable partner on the CF3-derived alkene carbon bearing retained F; net loss of two F
variable_role: reaction partner with open competing bond-forming atoms

lenses.description: Coverage expansion: neutral electron-rich aromatic partners, monocyclic and fused bicyclic scaffolds; oxygen-, nitrogen- and sulfur-bearing aromatics; competing carbon versus heteroatom bond formation. Do not restrict to preformed anions.

Coverage expansion across neutral and ionic precursors: O-H, N-H, S-H, P-H and cleavable element-element donors. Prefer interpretable precursor/state pairs and mixed versus symmetric donors; identify which atom could form the target bond.
